user.title: Add YKK AP Smart Lock
user.description: Enter the lock's BLE address manually. The official app must already have registered this lock with the management smartphone.

bluetooth.title: Add {name}
bluetooth.description: Bluetooth discovered the lock. Confirm that the official app has already registered it with the management smartphone.

register.title: Register YKK AP Smart Lock
register.description: On the registered management smartphone, select [本体設定・鍵の管理] → [鍵の管理] → [スマートフォン] → [追加登録] → [一般用スマートフォン] → [登録開始]. When the lock beeps, confirm that it is ready and continue.

data.ready: The lock is ready for general-use smartphone registration

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid BLE MAC address or platform Bluetooth UUID.
error.not_ready: Start registration from the registered management smartphone and confirm that the lock has beeped.
error.registration_failed: Registration failed. Check that the management smartphone is registered in the official app, registration has been started, the lock has beeped, and Home Assistant or its Bluetooth proxy is close enough for a BLE connection.

abort.already_configured: This YKK AP Smart Lock is already configured.
abort.not_connectable: The Bluetooth adapter found the lock but cannot connect to it.

register_device.name: Register as a general-use smartphone
register_device.description: After the registered management smartphone starts registration mode, register this Home Assistant Bluetooth connection as a general-use smartphone.

request_adv_key.name: Get state-synchronization information
request_adv_key.description: Get and save the information needed to retrieve and synchronize the lock's locked or unlocked state.

exit_registration.name: Exit registration mode
exit_registration.description: Exit the lock's registration mode after registration is complete.
